verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Sentry documents an official CLI at docs.sentry.io/cli, so the product itself provides the capability. The evidence is a single thin mention with no detail on commands, scope, or AI-native or agent-friendly use. Missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage, AI-native or agent workflow integration (e.g. machine-readable output, non-interactive auth), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
